title: San Diego Mountain Hike Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This easy hiking tour shows a different side of San Diego. The views are unforgettable. The freshness of nature instantly brings serenity into your experience as you hike and breathe in sage. While in the mountain we will take a moment to meditate with an experienced meditation teacher (optional). Your tour guide will provide multiple fun picture breaks so you can leave San Diego with memorable moments.
